limits: One ordered exploratory pair, no causal isolation or reverse/repeat control.
Both arms retain backend ring/DMA tracing; full-vs-metadata observer code/storage footprint differs too.
Nominal primary240MHz guest time and peripheral deadlines differ from wall time; approximate warm boundaries include rests/gaps.
Host counters are sampled read-only with gaps/start-exit exclusions and may not establish comparable effective execution conditions.
Complete byte reconstruction does not qualify synthesis, physical output, clean listening, a repair or publication.

release.purpose: Frozen normal-audio A full observer then B metadata-only if A qualifies; no silent control/retry/system change
